thread_title: Fraudulent ebay listing kaijly_0 Bloomington, Indiana
breadcrumb: Fraudulent ebay listing kaijly_0 Bloomington, Indiana

posts.body_html:
Buyers Beware! In case any of you have purchased from this seller, kaijly_0 located in Bloomington Indiana, they are using a photo of S. leucophylla var. alba Washington Co, AL and calling it hurricane creek white www.ebay.com/itm/Sarracenia-leucophylla-039-Hurricane-Creek-039-albino-rare-species-mature-size-2leads-/232661697341?nma=true&si=cNHYeylfm7BcRotmMLewE586VI4%253D&orig_cvip=true&rt=nc&_trksid=p2047675.l2557

How do I know this? The first picture is mine and I haven't given anyone permission to use it on ebay If you click on the picture, There's another picture in their listing which is S. leucophylla hurricane creek white clone E, another photograph I took! They are trying to pass off 2 different clones as one. In this case, what you see isn't what you're going to get, guaranteed!

Please share this on social media! Comments welcome and encouraged!

Of course, if you are kaijly_0 and would like this post to be deleted, please contact me and I'm happy to work with you: meizzwang@gmail.com There's no shame in correcting the error, and I don't know about others, but I'm a very forgiving person.
